notes: Smooth and keyboard-friendly everywhere: the page no longer fades and slides a moment after you type or edit (only a real page change animates); arrow keys glide the sheet and keep the cell clear of the sticky header and TOTAL row; PageUp/PageDown/Home/End scroll the sheet you are in (else the page) smoothly; Esc closes any dialog; on Bar Stock Issue the arrows join the Issue Slip and the register.
